 class TestMax:
     def test_max(self):

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name, expected', [('min', {'size': 1}), ('max', {'size': 9})])
+def test_min_max_attribute(name, expected):
+    template_env = Environment()
+    template_env.filters.update(ms.FilterModule().filters())
+    assert template_env.from_string("{{ values | %s(attribute='size') }}" % name).render(
+        values=[{'size': 9}, {'size': 1}]) == str(expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name, expected', [('min', 'B'), ('max', 'a')])
+def test_min_max_case_sensitive(name, expected):
+    assert getattr(ms, name)(env, ['a', 'B'], case_sensitive=True) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name', ['min', 'max'])
+def test_min_max_forwards_all_keywords(monkeypatch, name):
+    calls = []
+
+    def jinja_filter(environment, values, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((environment, values, kwargs))
+        return 'result'
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, 'do_' + name, jinja_filter)
+    values = [1, 2]
+    assert getattr(ms, name)(env, values, attribute='size', case_sensitive=True, custom='value') == 'result'
+    assert calls == [(env, values, {'attribute': 'size', 'case_sensitive': True, 'custom': 'value'})]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('name, available', [('min', 'HAS_MIN'), ('max', 'HAS_MAX')])
+def test_min_max_without_jinja2_filter(monkeypatch, name, available):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ms, available, False)
+    filter_func = getattr(ms, name)
+    assert filter_func(env, [1, 2]) == (1 if name == 'min' else 2)
+    for kwargs in ({'attribute': 'size'}, {'case_sensitive': False}, {'custom': 'value'}):
+        with pytest.raises(AnsibleFilterError) as error:
+            filter_func(env, [1, 2], **kwargs)
+        assert error.value.message == (
+            "Ansible's %s filter does not support any keyword arguments. "
+            "You need Jinja2 2.10 or later that provides their version of the filter." % name)
